style: 3D black office comedy, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE white goose clerk: big tomato-red vest, orange sleeve covers, navy tie, long neck.
second_characters: ONE squinting mole boss: purple vest, tiny thick glasses. THREE raccoon colleagues: lime-green shirts, sad faces. ONE tiny gosling, hatches at 9.40: red sleeve covers, navy tie.
props: Twig nest of gold eggs with ONE white egg: the goose's; gold eggs go into the raccoons' sleeves; the white egg stays in the goose's wings. Yellow shovel: the mole's, then stuck by the goose's neck, then the gosling's.
environment: Narrow ledge, 80th floor of a turquoise glass skyscraper, cyan sky. Window above; over it a navy sign, big white Cyrillic letters "БАНК РОССИИ", sharp and readable. At the foot: a soil square in yellow pavement.
lighting: Bright noon sun; warm key on the goose's face, amber rim left, hot-pink rim right; red vest and gold eggs vivid in every shot.
motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; cuts only at 2.80, 4.80, 7.38; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose dry deadpan adult voice; mole smug low voice

timeline.a: From the first frame the goose sits on the nest on the ledge; wind rolls a gold egg to the edge, he hooks it back with his beak.
timeline.c: camera plunges down the facade onto the nest

timeline.a: He fluffs up, wiggles, tucks the white egg under him; beak free, says
timeline.c: camera tumbles over the drop, sign in foreground

timeline.a: The window bursts open; three raccoons lean out and hug him sadly; he hisses.
timeline.c: camera whips up to the window

timeline.a: Under him raccoon paws pull gold eggs into their sleeves, push the white egg back; he gazes away, beak free, says
timeline.c: camera threads under the nest, twigs in foreground, close-up on a paw

timeline.a: The raccoons vanish; the mole pops out, sniffs, grips the empty nest.
The mole yanks the nest away like a tablecloth; the goose hangs in the air still sitting, wings hugging the white egg, then drops.
timeline.c: camera rolls upside down under him

timeline.a: The mole leans out and hurls the yellow shovel after him, mouth free, says
timeline.c: camera lunges into the mole's face, close-up

timeline.a: The goose falls down the facade, wings on the egg, never flapping, hissing up at the shovel.
timeline.c: camera free-falls face to face with him

timeline.a: At 7.38 he smacks into the soil square, soil fountains; the shovel stabs in an inch from his neck.
timeline.c: camera hurls itself in onto his face, close-up

timeline.a: Lying in the soil, he turns his head, one eye on the shovel, beak free, flatly says
timeline.c: camera tilts into his eye, close-up

timeline.a: The white egg in his wings cracks; the gosling climbs out and grabs the shovel with both paws.
timeline.c: camera skims the soil to the gosling, close-up
